event_summary: A right hand moves a small rectangular metal-looking piece on a metal-looking grid plate while a left hand rests on the plate.
raw_event_description: The view shows a flat gray metal-looking plate with rows of small rectangular raised pieces. A left hand remains on the left side of the plate. A right hand is visible at the right edge, grips a small rectangular piece near the lower-right area, moves it leftward and inward along the surface near an adjacent horizontal piece, holds it there for a period, then shifts the fingers upward and left over nearby raised pieces.

reasons: The plate, rows of raised pieces, left hand, right hand, and manipulated piece are visible.
The right hand is already near or touching a small piece at the right edge in the first frame.
